response.overview: Set in Bangkok in 2059, William, a data obstetrician, implants the life memories of his deceased aborted daughter into an AI robot called "Bangkok Baby". Endowed with human emotional memories, the AI girl travels across the city in search of her mother. From an artificial intelligence perspective, the film interweaves oriental family affection with futuristic technology, exploring the boundaries between AI, life and maternal love. Blending soft sci-fi storytelling with human warmth, it depicts the struggles and bonds of innate human emotions amid rapid technological advancement.
response.title: Baby Bangkok
